description:
Cast Stolen Identity by paying {4}{U}{U}, creating a token copy of Worldwalker Helm and a Map token.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping a Worldwaker Helm and a Map, adding {U}{U}.
Activate a Worldwalker Helm by paying {1}{U} and tapping it, creating a token copy of the Worldwalker Helm token plus a Map token for each Worldwalker Helm you control.
Activate Urza's first ability twice by tapping two Maps, adding {U}{U}.
Repeat from step 3.
